brief:
# Chat Viewer: every session stored, synced, searchable, exportable as 2-voice audio (Brett, Nov 1 ~3 AM)

Read CLAUDE.md, _claude/shared/rules/RULES.md, _claude/persona.md. Opus, one session. Git login works: plain `git push`. Merge origin/main first (other builds are landing).

Brett: store ALL our sessions (claude.ai text + voice chats, Claude Code sessions, headless build sessions) as transcripts in a viewer. When it loads, it checks for updates: new sessions, continued ones, changed ones, and updates the stored copies. Export any session as AUDIO with two separate voices: one for Brett, one for Claude (Amber).

IMPORTANT reality: claude.ai has no API to pull a user's chats, and we must NOT scrape claude.ai with Brett's login/cookies. Supported inputs:
1. Claude data export: Brett downloads it from claude.ai (Settings > Privacy > Export data) and uploads the zip (or conversations.json) in the viewer (phone file picker). Parse it, upsert by conversation uuid, detect new/changed by updated_at + message count/hash, keep versions.
2. Claude Code sessions: auto-sync the JSONL session files from ~/.claude/projects (root and axfbuild) on the VPS on a timer + on viewer load; incremental (byte offset/mtime).
3. Headless build logs (/root/axf-builds/*/*.log, /home/axfbuild/wt-*/*.log) as 'build sessions'.
4. Hub drop folder: Claude chat sessions can push conversations through axHub memory_write into project amberx-axf, area data, path `sessions/claude-ai/<uuid>.json` (schema below); the viewer ingests that folder too. Document the schema and add a line to _claude/shared/rules/RULES.md: when Brett says 'sync my chats', Claude uses recent_chats/read_conversation and writes each new/updated conversation there.

## Store
session@1 schema (framework/schemas + validators): id, source (claude-ai-text|claude-ai-voice|claude-code|headless|hub-drop), title, startedAt, updatedAt, project, messages [{role: user|assistant|tool, text, at, kind (speech|text|tool), toolName?}], hash, version history. Stored on the console data volume (SQLite or JSON files; your call, justify), not in git. Redact secrets (tokens/keys/passwords patterns) on ingest.

## Viewer (console plugin + AmberX entry 'Chats')
- List: framework DataGrid (sort/filter/search, date columns), source badges, 'updated' badge for changed sessions, counts.
- Full-text search across everything (SQLite FTS or similar), jump to the hit.
- Session view: chat bubbles (Brett vs Amber), tool calls collapsible, timestamps, copy/share, export text/markdown.
- 'Check for updates' on load + button: shows new/changed/unchanged counts.

## Audio export
- Export a session (or a range) as an audio file with TWO voices: Brett's voice and Amber's voice (configurable). Use a TTS that runs on this VPS for free by default (e.g. Piper with two different English voices; install into a container or venv, no GPU), with an optional provider setting (OpenAI/ElevenLabs) if a key is saved in the console keys. Skip tool-call noise; read only spoken/text turns; short pause between turns; chapters per hour. Output mp3/ogg stored on the hub, with a player in the viewer and a download link. Long sessions render in the background with progress.

Framework controls + theme/scale tokens only, phone-first. Tests: export-zip parsing + upsert/new/changed detection, Claude Code JSONL incremental sync, hub-drop ingest, redaction, search, audio render (short sample) with two voices. Local test block from .github/workflows/android.yml + theme/controls/lifecycle/menu-reach checks. Phone + desktop screenshots to UI Review via framework/cli/shot.mjs, group 'Chat viewer - Nov 1' (use demo/redacted sessions in screenshots). Add an install_steps part. Commit, fetch+merge origin/main, retest, `git push origin HEAD:main` (never force). Report at _claude/builds/reports/chat-viewer.md incl. how Brett gets his claude.ai export in.

steps.text: session@1 schema, JS validator, redaction, chain hash, fixtures + check
SQLite+FTS5 store with upsert, versions, seen badges
Ingesters: claude.ai export zip, Claude Code JSONL incremental, build logs, hub drop
Server routes + sync timer + check for updates
Audio: Piper setup, two-voice mixer, mp3 + chapters, cloud providers, background jobs
Web viewer: DataGrid list, search, bubbles, export, audio player, settings
Tests, lifecycle, deploy mounts, AmberX entry, RULES line, install steps
Checks, screenshots to UI Review, report, merge main, push

open: MP3s have no embedded ID3 chapter frames; chapters live in the sidecar and the viewer's chapter buttons.
AmberX: uploads over 12 MB refused by its console forwarder (import big exports from the console).
New `/home/axfbuild/wt-*` worktrees reach the console after the next `install-console.sh` run (one mount each; the axfbuild home itself is never mounted because it holds git credentials).

The console needs that installer re-run once to get the read-only mounts; until then the viewer shows only what the container itself has (its own Claude Code sessions) plus imports and the hub drop folder.
Piper isn't installed until someone taps Set up free voices (~130 MB with two voices).
The export's voice-mode detection is heuristic (no documented field).
